name: Sebastiano
text: Sebastiano signed the delivery in while the driver waited at the gate. Two pallets arrived, seals unbroken. The copy is filed in the office folder.

name: Garcia
text: Garcia recorded the meter readings for both units at the start of the shift. Gas sat at 41 and electric at 88. The numbers match last week almost exactly. A note was made about the flickering light.

name: Bankowski Odigie
text: Bankowski Odigie opened the job for the loose ceiling tile in corridor C and taped the area off straight away. The tile itself was intact and was refitted the same afternoon. Dust sheets stayed down overnight because of the pipework above. Scaffold booking is pending, follow up Friday.

name: Da Soler
text: Da Soler checked the escape lights on the north side and found one dead battery. The unit was swapped from stock.

name: Jeyavathany
text: Jeyavathany tested the emergency alarm on the loading dock and the bell rang clean in the office. The reset worked first time. A sticker was added to the panel with the test date.

name: Dewa
text: Dewa logged the parking barrier fault and raised it with the site manager before the evening traffic. The arm stays up overnight so nobody gets stuck. A temporary sign points drivers to the side entrance. The engineer is due before the weekend. Security will check the lane twice a night.

name: Liisa Baroness
text: Liisa Baroness posted the updated fire action notices on all four floors after the reminder from the assessor. Old ones went in recycling.

name: Sadil Giangiacomo
text: Sadil Giangiacomo rebuilt the weekend rota after two swaps came in late and pinned it by the clocking machine. The changes were read out at handover. The original sheet was left underneath for reference.

name: Aiman
text: Aiman closed out the moisture report for the basement after the fans ran for three days. Readings came back under the limit on every wall and the dehumidifiers were collected. The report goes to the insurer with the photos attached. A recheck is booked for the spring.

name: Rocak
text: Rocak noted the lift door judder and reported it twice. The second call got a same day visit. The fault was in the runner.

name: Makso Jawahar
text: Makso Jawahar inspected the new hand dryer in the annex washroom and the sensor works from a sensible distance. A second unit was ordered for the east block. Fitting takes about twenty minutes each.

name: Justus Ohanyan
text: Justus Ohanyan rewired the label bench after the fuse tripped three mornings in a row. The old extension block was found scorched and binned. A surge protector now sits between the wall socket and the bench. No trips since the change. The electrician signed it off Thursday lunchtime.

name: Morato
text: Morato cleared the blocked gutter over the bike shelter and flushed the downpipe. No leak on the wall now. Ladders back on the van.

name: Zahra
text: Zahra: press 4 stops mid cycle, likely the feed sensor. An engineer is booked for Thursday. Production moved to press 2 so the order stays on track. Watch the scrap count until then.

name: Tesfagabr
text: Tesfagabr: aisle 3 bay 7. Missing dividers, six of them. Stock take shows the count is right so they likely went out with the last picks. Reorder placed with the catalog number attached. New dividers land Tuesday. Aisle 4 was checked for strays and is clear.

name: Guthe Gualberti
text: Guthe Gualberti: line 6 changeover late by forty minutes, cause was a stuck guard. Handover note left. Tooling cleaned before storage.

name: Timor Jerom
text: Timor Jerom: chiller 1 door seal replaced. Temperature back to 3.2 overnight. Old seal kept for the warranty claim. Next week the same job runs on chiller 2 if the reading drifts again.

name: Béni
text: Béni: gate 3 loop detector faulty, barrier stays down after each entry. Manual override in use for now with a marshal on the entrance. Replacement part ordered priority and tracked. Should land before the weekend rush. Drivers have been told to use the north gate instead.

name: Blasco
text: Blasco: kitchen extract filters washed and refitted. Two were too worn and went in the bin. Replacements on order. Tags updated on the log.

name: Sidra Inge-Marie
text: Sidra Inge-Marie: parcel cage emptied and the three strays went back to reception. Labels reprinted for the two found without addresses. Courier pickup signed. The cage key is back on the board hook.

name: von Franz
text: von Franz: stair press machine guard replaced and the interlock retested. All stations pass. The old guard had a hairline crack near the hinge and was sent for scrap. Operators briefed on the change at handover. Next inspection is booked for the twelfth. Photo record saved with the work order.

name: Folke
text: Folke: first aid room restocked, plasters and two cold packs. Log book signed. The eye wash bottle expires in June so it stays on the list.

name: Dropmann
text: Dropmann: loading ramp edge painted and drying. Use the side door until tomorrow morning. Tape removed after the paint sets. The stores team moved the trolleys so nothing rolls over the wet strip.

name: Zerabruk Silic
text: Zerabruk Silic: monthly ladder checks done. One set of feet replaced and the rest tagged. The alloy steps in the van were swapped for the spare set because the top tread was dented. New feet arrive from the supplier next week. Photos of the dents went to the tool store.

name: Xhem Adolph
text: Xhem Adolph: sample fridge alarms tested and the battery light is green. Door seals wiped. Two racks relabeled. The log sheet is in the clip.

name: Kollitsch
text: Kollitsch: roof hatch rehung and the gas strut replaced. It holds open now without the prop stick. The old stick was removed from the wall to avoid confusion. A label shows the safe opening angle.

name: Cilgia
text: The quarterly pest check was completed with no activity found in the kitchens and the log was signed off. Cilgia walked the contractor through the back yard and the store cupboards. Bait stations were replaced as a precaution. The report is filed in the compliance folder. Next visit is due in twelve weeks time.

name: Tesfagiorgis
text: The new keyboard for the kiosk was fitted and tested. Tesfagiorgis checked every key and then wiped the unit down.

name: Tiani Prontera Schmuziger
text: The overnight temperature log was completed without gaps and the readings all sat in range. Tiani Prontera Schmuziger initialled the sheet and filed it in the binder by the fridges. A spare pen is clipped to the cover.

name: Heavenly Gualzata
text: The van checklist for the week came back complete and the mileage was logged against each trip. Heavenly Gualzata flagged a slow puncture on the rear tyre and booked it in for Friday. The spare was checked and is sound. Fuel cards were reconciled at the same time.

name: Flanza
text: The broken coat hooks in the cloakroom were swapped for new ones. Flanza touched up the paint and cleared the floor.

name: Zesch
text: The canteen fridge was deep cleaned and the shelves were relabelled by category. Zesch checked the date labels on every tub and binned the old stock. The next clean is on the rota for Friday.

name: Grace Wilson
text: The pushchair came back from repair this morning and the brake now holds on the ramp. Grace Wilson tested the harness clips and signed the handover sheet at the desk. The loan pushchair goes back to storage. Parents were told at pick up time and the log was updated.

name: El Chami
text: The vending machine float was counted and banked at lunchtime. El Chami noted the two shortfalls in the book. A note went to the route manager too.

name: Vinit
text: The tills were cashed up early because the till system needed an update. Vinit ran the update and checked the receipt roll on both machines. Change was ordered for the weekend float.

name: Dumitra
text: The safety briefing for the new battery tools was delivered to both shifts and the attendance sheet is full. Dumitra demonstrated the lock out procedure and answered questions about the charger fire risk. A follow up drill is set for the end of the month. The toolkit passed a quick check after the talk.

name: Provost Stehmann
text: The strip lights in the corridor were tested and one ballast was swapped. Provost Stehmann then cleaned the diffusers. The spare ballast box is back in the store.

name: Ramazanoski Matergia Bennie
text: The site hut was cleaned out and the old drawings were recycled. Ramazanoski Matergia Bennie checked the first aid kit and replaced the missing gloves. A new notice went up about the smoking area.

name: Dhananjay
text: Bay 12 turnover finished ahead of schedule and the tooling was cleaned before storage. Dhananjay entered the run time and the scrap count into the board. The next job is queued for the morning. No changeover overruns this week. The weekend crew gets the easier sequence.

name: Panghe
text: Bin 4 was emptied and the lid hinge was oiled. Panghe noted the bin liner stock is low. Order goes in on Monday.

name: Isée Yaële
text: The despatch list was checked against the loaded pallets and all three matched. Isée Yaële signed the gate pass and the driver left on time. The manifest copy stays in the office tray tonight.

name: Pimpinella Maheswararasa
text: Line 5 ran the full shift without a stop and the output beat the target by sixty units. Pimpinella Maheswararasa logged the figures and flagged two worn belts for the weekend service. Quality checks came back clean. The belts are already on site in the store.

name: Michelle
text: The returns trolley was cleared and every item was scanned back in. Michelle bagged the damaged ones for the supplier.

name: Frenk
text: The pallet labels for the export order were reprinted and the old ones were shredded. Frenk checked the new set against the manifest before the lorry arrived. The lorry left the yard before four.

name: Lakshiga Lacheta
text: The cycle count for the fasteners aisle finished early and the variance report came back clean for the third month. Lakshiga Lacheta flagged two bins with faded labels for reprinting. The reprint list goes to the office tomorrow. Counting will speed up once the new bins arrive.

name: Amazona Misic Sarakoglou
text: The spill kit was checked and one absorbent pad roll was replaced. Amazona Misic Sarakoglou restocked the gloves. The old roll was logged as used.

name: Sim
text: The handover notes were checked and the open jobs were carried over to the new sheet. Sim updated the whiteboard before the shift change. Two jobs need parts and are on hold until Tuesday.

name: Elsherbiny
text: The weekend stock count was signed off without adjustments and the count sheets were filed in the cabinet. Elsherbiny noted the freezer drawer labels need replacing. A reprint run is scheduled for Monday. No shortages were found this round. A fresh roll of label stock is on the shelf.

name: Bengül Bute
text: The display fridge was defrosted overnight and the trays were washed. Bengül Bute relabeled the shelves. The unit is back at temperature now.

name: Pietro Santhos
text: The meeting room was set up for the training session and the projector was tested. Pietro Santhos put out the handouts and checked the spare batteries. The room was reset afterwards with the chairs back in rows.
